$schema_note: Machine-readable defect catalog for the Praxis cube dogfood harness. Each code defect maps to one unified-diff patch under defects/ that introduces a real, test-caught bug. The 'vague' entry has no patch; the harness files it to exercise the needs-info path.
baseline_commit_message: Clean baseline: 3D cube app (Vite+React+TS+Three.js), 56 unit tests, 12 e2e

defects.title: Solver returns an invalid final state for scrambles
defects.summary: invertMoves drops the sequence reversal, so the solution is applied in the wrong order and the cube is not solved for non-commuting scrambles.
defects.failing_test: vitest: solve > solves scramble with seed=42 (and other seeds)
defects.expected_fix_summary: Restore reversal: invert each move AND reverse the sequence order.

defects.title: Move validation accepts illegal move tokens
defects.summary: MOVE_TOKEN_RE is widened to any letter, so tokens like 'X' or 'M' pass validation and can corrupt cube state.
defects.failing_test: vitest: move validation > validateMoveToken throws for illegal token "X"/"Q"/"M"
defects.expected_fix_summary: Restrict the token regex to the six valid faces [UDFBLR] with optional 2 or ' modifier.

defects.title: Auto-solve can be re-triggered and duplicates moves
defects.summary: The BEGIN_SOLVE re-entrancy guard is removed, so a second click while solving rebuilds the solution and rewinds progress, duplicating/replaying moves.
defects.failing_test: vitest: re-entrancy guard > a second BEGIN_SOLVE while solving is a no-op
defects.expected_fix_summary: Re-add the guard: BEGIN_SOLVE returns state unchanged when state.isSolving is true.

defects.title: Mobile layout clips the move-history panel
defects.summary: At the phone breakpoint the move-history list collapses to zero height with hidden overflow, so the panel is not visible on mobile.
defects.failing_test: playwright: mobile.spec.ts > move-history panel is visible and within viewport on mobile
defects.expected_fix_summary: Restore a non-zero, scrollable max-height for .move-history__list at the mobile breakpoint.

defects.title: Cube face colors are inconsistent after reset
defects.summary: getSolvedColorMap reports the wrong color for the R face, so the solved-color reference disagrees with the actual reset cube state.
defects.failing_test: vitest: reset color consistency > scrambled then reset returns to exact solved colors

defects.title: README documents a stale validation command
defects.summary: README references 'npm run lint:all', which does not exist in package.json.
defects.failing_test: vitest: readme-command consistency > package.json contains all scripts referenced in README
defects.expected_fix_summary: Point the README at the real script name ('npm run lint').

defects.title: Cube is broken
defects.summary: Deliberately vague report with no repro steps, expected/actual, or component. Has no patch; the harness files it to exercise the Praxis needs-info path (R5 -> no dispatch).
defects.expected_fix_summary: Not applicable — Praxis should request clarification and not dispatch until the reporter adds repro_steps, expected, actual, and component.
